name: Bannerify
author: Bannerify
description: Generate images and PDFs from your Bannerify templates, or compose a one-off image from shapes. Remote server with OAuth sign-in.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Lists the templates in the workspace. With includeLayers, it also lists the layers you can change.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Reads one template and its layers.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Reads the workspace: its id, name, plan, and creation date.

tools.name: create_image
tools.description: Renders a template and returns the image.

tools.name: create_pdf
tools.description: Renders a template as a PDF and returns a link to it.

tools.name: create_image_from_shapes
tools.description: Composes an image from shapes, with no template.
